# MMLU-Pro scoring audit (generated by analysis/fu_mc_parse_audit.py)

**Post hoc, exploratory** (DEVIATIONS D19). The frozen scorer `src/score/mc.py` 1.0.0 stays primary; its results are in `reports/v2_02_mc_results.md`. Test split. An output without a frozen letter (truncated or unparsed) is class (a) if the last box starts with a valid option letter followed by end or punctuation (the frozen pattern misses "H, with reservations ..."), (m) if that box also names other option letters ("A, I, G, H"), (b) if the last box holds other text, (c) if there is no complete box. Rule v1 (fixed before the first run, commit bebeb7d) had no class (m) and read those boxes as their first letter; reading the samples showed the error, and rule v2 adds (m). The sensitivity scorers read class (a) as its letter (v1: also (m)), on both splits. 95 % cluster-bootstrap CIs (clusters = canonical stem), pp; AUROC differences × 100.
